name: marklens
description: 免费的 Markdown 编辑、维护与 EPUB 阅读工具。Free Markdown editor, maintenance tool, and EPUB reader.
author: syd191

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.pack: npm run build && node scripts/buildWindows.mjs portable && node scripts/verifyWindowsBuild.mjs portable
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/buildWindows.mjs nsis zip && node scripts/verifyWindowsBuild.mjs nsis zip
scripts.dist:enterprise: npm run build && node scripts/buildWindows.mjs msi zip && node scripts/verifyWindowsBuild.mjs msi zip
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm audit --omit=dev
